fromWeb reads Headers.getSetCookie(), removes the textual header and parses it with Cookies.fromSetCookie.
Cookies retains value and maxAge/path/httpOnly/sameSite options. Its serializer writes Max-Age before Path, followed by HttpOnly and SameSite.
NodeHttpServer.handleResponse uses Cookies.toSetCookieHeaders for its actual network response, the same serializer used by HttpServerResponse.toWeb.
The shared installation fixture regex requires Max-Age last; it therefore rejects the source-derived canonical transport ordering.
